items.title: Hair Supplies
items.excerpt: An e-commerce led engagement, helping an East Fremantle hair retailer go national.
items.summary: An e-commerce led engagement, helping an East Fremantle hair retailer go national.
items.bodyHtml:
After decades of providing dedicated professional experience and genuine customer service to a national client base, it was time for Hair Supplies to grow their online presence.

As their business evolved, Hair Supplies found themselves catering to two distinct customer groups, trade and retail. Their existing e-commerce platform lacked distinction between the two customer bases, resulting in a blurring of their product offering. An invigorated digital platform was essential to serving these two distinctive audiences, without distilling their established brand and reputation for exceptional service.

Despite being a smaller business within a highly competitive market, Hair Supplies has managed to do more than hold its own. Through their highly personable customer service, Hair Supplies have developed a reputation for delivering unparalleled value and knowledge to their national customer base. Pivoting with the times, the Hair Supplies team wanted to focus more on their online presence, requiring a website that would deliver that same genuine user experience and journey.

OKMG was engaged to create a website to facilitate an effortless online user experience for the Hair Supplies loyal, and growing customer base, while maintaining the same high quality of experience provided in-store.

The first step was to separate their existing website into two different websites from the back end that would not disrupt the user journey from the home page: one for Trade Customers and one for Retail. From there we designed two seamlessly linked Shopify websites.

The new Hair Supplies websites meant an effortless customer’s user journey. Enhancing the shopping experience, especially for busy hair care professionals, allows them to shop and checkout efficiently for every day or even last minute hair products.

In merging Shopify stores with Retail Management Hero we enabled the Hair Supplies team to efficiently manage all their back office, inventors and POS activities across several channels. We were able to perfectly embody the genuine and inviting customer service that the Hair Supplies team provides, giving them leverage within the generic online retail space.

items.title: West Australian Crystal Crab
items.excerpt: OKMG built Southern Trading Australia’s immersive digital platform spotlighting the West Australian crystal crab for the international culinary market.
items.summary: OKMG built Southern Trading Australia’s immersive digital platform spotlighting the West Australian crystal crab for the international culinary market.
items.bodyHtml:
When Southern Trading Australia needed to showcase their exclusive West Australian Crystal Crab, aka Snow Crab (Latin: Chaceon albus) to the global culinary market, they required a brand and digital presence that matched the premium quality of their sustainably sourced deep-sea delicacy. Given our past experience in delivering branding projects for high-end products, we immediately understood that this meant creating a digital experience that captured both the uniqueness of the product itself and Southern Trading Australia’s standing as Western Australia’s principal supplier of crystal crab. It was crucial to connect well with discerning chefs and gourmet food enthusiasts who demand both quality and transparency.

We commenced with a deep discovery period into the nuances of deep-sea crustaceans in domestic and international markets. Our exploration process covered competitor considerations, brand attributes, tone and style and spread across terroir, as well as geographical and lexical territories. We ultimately named the product ‘West Australian Crystal Crab’ to clearly identify its origin and to distinguish it from the generic ‘Snow Crab’ label used for several inferior species globally (e.g. Alaskan snow crab). This name also emphasises our role as the primary supplier of Chaceon albus in Western Australia.

After naming, we developed a custom brand identity centring around a custom type-driven logo with gold texturing directed at China as the primary market. We then explored various concepts for a website experience that presented the crystal crab product as the hero ingredient it truly is. The "Our Crab" page serves two purposes: to guide users through the deep-water (500m+) environment of the West Australian Crystal Crab and to showcase the range of other premium products supplied by Southern Trading Australia. Then we designed a digital experience to illuminate the Crystal Crab's pristine deep-sea habitat, its responsibly managed harvest, and its unparalleled, sweet flavour profile, establishing its status as the world's finest crab. The website features stunning product photography, educational content about the crab's habitat and harvesting process, and clear messaging around MSC certification and sustainability credentials.

The result is a one-of-a-kind digital platform befitting a culinary treasure such as the West Australian Crystal Crab. Through abyssal sea blue, gold accents, and compelling storytelling, the website communicates the product’s exclusivity, sustainability and superior quality. We are so proud to play our part in connecting Australia's finest deep-sea delicacy with the world’s most demanding culinary artists.

seo.title: West Australian Crystal Crab | Work | Website Development Perth
seo.description: OKMG built Southern Trading Australia’s immersive digital platform spotlighting the West Australian crystal crab for the international culinary market.

items.title: BCI Minerals
items.excerpt: OKMG delivered a custom modern website for BCI Minerals, integrating live investor data and internal systems for clear shareholder communications.
items.summary: OKMG delivered a custom modern website for BCI Minerals, integrating live investor data and internal systems for clear shareholder communications.
items.bodyHtml:
Overview

BCI Minerals, an ASX-listed company with a $1.32 billion market capitalisation, is a major player in the industrial minerals sector. Presently, it is advancing its flagship Mardie salt and potash project alongside its legacy iron ore interests. The company required a digital presence that not only reflected its scale and ambition but also served as an efficient, multi-functional tool for its growing team and increasing market audience. This case study details how OKMG partnered with BCI to transform their online presence, moving from a restrictive, developer-dependent platform to a modern, integrated and self-sufficient website that powers investor relations, recruitment and brand communication.

The Brief

BCI Minerals faced a critical challenge: their previous website was a bottleneck to effective communication. Constrained by an outdated content management system (CMS), even routine content updates became protracted exercises, requiring technical tickets and leading to weeks of lead time. This hindered the marketing team’s ability to share timely updates with stakeholders, investors and potential employees. The brief was clear: deliver a modern, authoritative and scalable digital platform whose core objectives were to:

  • Empower the internal team: Transition to a self-sufficient CMS and eliminate dependency on developers for routine content updates.
  • Boost brand authority: Create a visually compelling site that accurately represents the scale of BCI’s operations and project portfolio.
  • Streamline investor communications: Integrate a centralised Investor Hub with live data to enable compliance, transparency and accessibility.
  • Integrate with internal systems: Connect the website with BCI’s existing technology stack to unify workflows and data.

Discovery and Strategy

OKMG initiated the project with a discovery phase to fully understand BCI Minerals’ complex needs. This structured process involved stakeholder workshops and technical discussions covering sitemap and information architecture (IA) reviews, feature and integration planning, visual direction scoping, and technical requirements for hosting, DNS, GA4 and SEO. A critical component of this phase was the close collaboration with BCI’s strategic marketing advisor, Madeline Arnold Advisory, who provided the foundational copy deck, site structure and user journeys.

Content and Copywriting

While the foundational copy was developed by Madeline Arnold Advisory, OKMG’s role was to structure and present this content within the new digital ecosystem. We focused on translating the strategic narrative into a dynamic web experience. This involved planning how the content would flow across different pages, identifying opportunities for visual storytelling (such as neat timelines for the Mardie project) and structuring information hierarchies to guide users intuitively.

Design and User Experience

With the strategy and content framework in place, OKMG’s design team began translating BCI’s brand identity. The focus was on creating a clean, organised, and visually authoritative interface befitting an ASX-listed company.

Mockups

We explored several digital design concepts in Figma, pushing the visual application of BCI’s brand assets, fonts, and guidelines. After selecting a preferred direction, we developed mockups for key pages to secure stakeholder and board approval. These designs incorporated dynamic elements such as full-width video headers, subtle animations to enhance storytelling, smooth-scrolling experiences and interactive click-through carousels for project imagery. The chosen direction was then refined through two to three rounds of iterative feedback before being systematically applied to the entire sitemap.

User Journeys

Working from the user journeys defined during discovery, we designed intuitive pathways for BCI’s key audience segments. For investors, the journey was streamlined towards the integrated Investor Hub. For potential job candidates, clear calls-to-action led them directly to live listings. For media and project stakeholders, the architecture surfaced project information (Mardie salt and potash, legacy iron ore) with ease.

Development

The development phase focused on building a robust, future-proof platform. OKMG delivered a high-performance WordPress website made for speed, security and administrative autonomy. At the heart of this was the implementation of ACF Flexible Content. This enabled the BCI marketing team to build and modify pages at will using a library of pre-designed, pre-coded content blocks. This system effectively future-proofed the site, giving the client complete control to create campaign landing pages or update project information without a single line of code or a developer ticket.

Systems Integrations

A key requirement was to break down data silos by integrating the new website with BCI’s core business systems. OKMG built custom connections that preserved existing workflows and eliminated manual data duplication.

ASX

Working in partnership with Weblink, we integrated a comprehensive Investor Hub. This feature is a centralised repository for all market-sensitive information, featuring live ASX share price data, a fully searchable library of annual reports and presentations, and an automated feed of ASX announcements. This replaced a fragmented system of manual PDF uploads. It also keeps information current, compliant and accessible from any device.

Job Board

To streamline recruitment, we integrated the site with Action HRM, BCI’s human resources platform. This custom integration ensures that job listings on the website are automatically populated and synchronised with Action HRM. When a position is filled or a new role is created in the HR system, the website then updates instantly.

HIVO

We connected the website to HIVO, BCI’s digital asset management (DAM) system. This integration allows staff to pull approved, high-resolution imagery and brand assets directly into the CMS when building pages. This ensures brand consistency, maintains a single source of truth for creative assets, and saves time otherwise spent on manual downloading and uploading.

AGOL Maps

To dynamically showcase the location and scale of their operations, we integrated the site with ArcGIS Online (AGOL). This allows BCI to embed interactive, data-rich maps directly onto project pages, providing stakeholders with a powerful visual tool to understand the company's geographical footprint.

Mailchimp and Newsletter

Finally, we integrated Mailchimp to support segmented stakeholder communications. The website’s newsletter sign-up forms are connected to specific audience lists within Mailchimp, enabling BCI’s communications team to manage investor alerts, community updates and corporate news through their existing email marketing platform, all driven by subscriptions gathered on the website.

SEO and Security

Throughout the development process, we adhered to best practices for on-page SEO, including optimising site structure, meta-data and page speed. The clean, semantic codebase and fast-loading ACF architecture contribute to strong search engine visibility. On the security front, we implemented a robust security framework including SSL encryption, regular core and plugin updates, and secure hosting protocols to protect sensitive company and investor data.

Test and Launch

Prior to launch, the site underwent rigorous testing across devices and browsers. We worked closely with the BCI team to migrate content, configure the new integrations and conduct final user acceptance testing (UAT). The launch was executed with a carefully managed DNS cutover to minimise downtime. Following the go-live, we entered a hypercare period to provide immediate, hands-on support to monitor performance, address any minor adjustments and ensure the BCI team was confident in managing their new platform.

Ongoing Support

Following launch and hypercare period, BCI Minerals transitioned to OKMG’s managed support service. This ongoing partnership involves regular platform maintenance, security updates, plugin management and high-priority technical assistance as needed.

Outcome

A clean, organised website that accurately reflects BCI Minerals’ scale and ambition in the global industrial minerals market. The internal marketing team now publishes content and campaign pages without developer support. Investor information is consolidated, current and accessible from any device. Core business systems (like creative assets, email distribution and human resources) now run through a unified interface. Post-launch analytics are also in place to track time-on-site across investor and careers sections.

seo.description: OKMG delivered a custom modern website for BCI Minerals, integrating live investor data and internal systems for clear shareholder communications.

items.title: Long Point Brewing Co.
items.excerpt: Phased Shopify launch builds momentum for Kennedy Bay's coastal brewery through distinctive voice and strategic digital presence.
items.summary: Phased Shopify launch builds momentum for Kennedy Bay's coastal brewery through distinctive voice and strategic digital presence.
items.bodyHtml:
The Client

Long Point Brewing Co. is an independent craft brewery developing a two-storey brewpub and restaurant on the Kennedy Bay foreshore. With construction currently underway and a target opening in early 2026, the venture aims to become a coastal destination.

The Challenge

With construction in progress, Long Point Brewing Co. faced the challenge of building a digital presence before the physical venue was complete. They needed a website that could generate excitement and anticipation well ahead of their early 2026 opening. The primary challenge extended beyond a typical pre-launch page because the digital presence had to capture the brewery’s laid-back coastal spirit, establish a unique voice that differentiated itself from standard brewery marketing, and set clear expectations for the brand's personality and future guest experience while the venue itself was still being built.

The Solution

To address these needs, OKMG partnered with Long Point Brewing Co. to deliver a Shopify website designed for strategic, phased deployment. The project began with a streamlined soft launch focused on brand storytelling. This allows the brewery to establish its online identity and engage with the community immediately. The design and copy worked in unison to create a digital reflection of the coastal environment, using refreshingly unpretentious language to bring the founders’ vision of creating “a brewery that feels like home” to life.

This initial site was built on a flexible Shopify platform to accommodate future growth, launching with pages that communicated the brand story, the founders' vision and provided contact functionality. With this foundation in place, the platform is now fully prepared for its next phase, which will introduce operational features. These will include detailed venue and menu information, online booking systems, dedicated function space details and an integrated e-commerce shop to support the full needs of the brewery upon its grand opening.

The Result

OKMG successfully launched a brand-centric digital presence for Long Point Brewing Co. that builds momentum and fosters a connection with future customers well in advance of the physical opening. By leveraging a phased approach on Shopify, OKMG ensured that the website is a scalable marketing and operational platform ready to support the full needs of this exciting coastal destination upon its grand opening.

seo.description: Phased Shopify launch builds momentum for Kennedy Bay's coastal brewery through distinctive voice and strategic digital presence.

items.title: The Sports MAP Network
items.excerpt: OKMG rebuilt The Sports MAP Network’s digital platform for sports medicine professionals, improving conversion rates and driving more masterclass subscriptions.
items.summary: OKMG rebuilt The Sports MAP Network’s digital platform for sports medicine professionals, improving conversion rates and driving more masterclass subscriptions.
items.bodyHtml:
The client

The Sports MAP Network is Australia's premier continuing professional development platform for sports medicine clinicians. The organisation delivers masterclasses, filmed conferences and live events featuring presenters from AFL and Cricket Australia physios to renowned researchers from La Trobe University and the UK Sports Institute. With a growing community of sports physios, athletic trainers and allied health professionals across Australia, New Zealand, the UK and the USA, The Sports MAP Network had built a following through consistently excellent content. But their digital platform wasn't keeping pace with their ambition. 

The challenge

The Sports MAP Network team was upfront about the challenges that needed to be addressed. Years of iterative additions had left them with a site running on 75 plugins, a technical debt that made every update feel like walking through treacle. Load times were suffering, the user journey from discovery to purchase had unnecessary friction, and the LifterLMS dashboard, which is the heart of the member experience, felt disconnected from the brand’s professional identity.

The team also wanted to improve how they converted visitors into members. The pricing and subscription logic needed to accommodate complex offers (event bundles, location‑based currency switching, multi‑seat team package, etc.). The checkout process needed simplifying, as well. The sign‑up flow needed to feel more personalised. And with a growing international audience, the platform had to handle multiple currencies and tax jurisdictions.

Add to that a wishlist of strategic new features: a group chat for masterclass members, a careers and job board with admin approval workflows, member‑only search functionality, social certificate sharing for CPD credentials, and deeper integration between WooCommerce and LifterLMS. All while protecting the active subscription data of their existing member base, a non‑negotiable requirement that ruled out any risky one‑click migrations.

Our approach

OKMG understood, from our first conversations with the Sports MAP Network team, that this was an opportunity to build a high‑performance digital foundation that could scale with the business for years to come. 

We started with the basics: a logo refresh and updated brand palette that sharpened the visual identity without losing the recognition existing members had come to trust. Cleaner typography, more purposeful use of colour and a design system that would flow consistently through every touchpoint from marketing pages to the member dashboard.

With the brand foundations in place, we then moved into a full website redesign in Figma. Every page was interrogated through the lens of conversion. Where was the friction? What questions were going unanswered? How could we make the path from “interested clinician” to “active subscriber” feel effortless? The answer lay partly in design, and partly in user journey mapping. We restructured the navigation to have clearer pathways to relevant content to better serve individuals looking to upskill, clinic managers seeking team packages, and international clinicians navigating CPD requirements. The new onboarding quiz now guides new members to masterclasses suited to their experience level and clinical interests.

The checkout process underwent a complete overhaul. Where previously users encountered friction at multiple points, we streamlined the flow and integrated Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay for maximum payment flexibility. Complex discount logic (bundling events with subscriptions, offering team pricing, and managing multi‑currency transactions) now runs smoothly in the background.

One major focus was the LifterLMS dashboard reskin. This is where members spend most of their time, and it needed to feel like a natural extension of the brand and not a generic plugin interface. We redesigned the dashboard to prioritise what matters: easy access to recent masterclasses, clear CPD tracking, downloadable certificates and smooth navigation between content types.

Backend optimisation was equally critical. We reduced the plugin count from over 75 to approximately 40, replacing bloated plugins with lean custom code where it made sense. The result is a faster, more secure platform that's easier to maintain and harder to breach.

The migration from staging to production was precise. Rather than a risky one‑click push, OKMG executed a careful, phased migration that preserved every active subscription, every member record, every piece of historical data. 

New Capabilities

Beyond the core rebuild, we delivered a suite of features to deepen member engagement and open new revenue streams:

  • Group chat for masterclass members. A dedicated space where subscribers can discuss content, share insights and build professional connections.
  • Careers and job board. A natural extension for a platform serving elite clinicians. With admin approval workflows to ensure quality control, employers can post roles, and members can browse opportunities.
  • Member‑only search. Subscribers can now search the entire content library from a single interface.
  • Podcast and blog integration. To support top‑of‑funnel discovery that feeds membership growth, free content now lives alongside paid offerings in a unified ecosystem.
  • Social certificate sharing. Members can share their CPD achievements on professional networks directly from the platform.
  • Location‑based currency switcher. International members now see pricing in their local currency automatically. This reduces checkout friction for UK, European and US audiences.
  • GA4 setup with conversion tracking. Real visibility into what's working, from traffic sources to checkout completion rates, so the team can continue optimising based on data.

The outcome

The Sports MAP Network now has a digital platform that matches the quality of its content. The new site is faster, more secure and easier to manage. But the real measure of success is in the numbers. Since launch, the team has seen a measurable uplift in conversion rates across key pages. The simplified checkout process has reduced drop‑off at the point of purchase. The improved sign‑up flow, combined with the personalised onboarding quiz, is turning more free trial users into paying members. And the new group chat and job board are driving repeat visits and longer session times, which is exactly the engagement metrics that matter for a subscription business. As they continue to expand their offering and reach new clinicians around the world, the foundation remains solid. And we'll be right here, cheering them on.

items.title: Albany Herring
items.excerpt: OKMG enables Albany Herring’s complete brand transformation from sea to shelf to create resonant positioning for Western Australia’s prized herring.
items.summary: OKMG enables Albany Herring’s complete brand transformation from sea to shelf to create resonant positioning for Western Australia’s prized herring.
items.bodyHtml:
Albany Herring is a research project supported by Curtin University, undertaking a real-world trial in commercialising Australian Herring caught in Albany, Western Australia and selling for retail and wholesale consumption (previously just commercially as bait). It is a unique product that is abundant in numbers, with a long-nostalgic history with families across Australia caught hobby-fishing.

OKMG were approached to deliver a complete naming, brand identity, product packaging concepts and website design & development, to craft and share their authentic Great Southern fishing story. OKMG went beyond simple rebranding and developed a richly layered brand ecosystem beginning with strategic naming and brand identity creation for both Captain Redbeard’s Great Southern Fishery and the consumer-facing 'Albany Herring' product brand. 

We delved into the inspiring (based on a true-ish story) narrative of Captain Redbeard, the Swedish adventurer whose maritime legacy became the basis for Albany's fishing heritage, then brought this story to life through distinctive visual identity and packaging design. The integrated Captain Redbeard story creates a background for the Albany Herring product and the packaging design ensures shelf impact in both wholesale and retail environments. We also produced a video with local footage of the catch process, to show their sustainable catch method (purse seine), circling the school with a giant net from shore, highlighting the care and community spirit in every catch.

The resulting website showcases the Albany Herring project and their commitment to sustainability and the nutritional benefits of this local Australian fish - “As fresh as the sea is wild.”

seo.description: OKMG enables Albany Herring’s complete brand transformation from sea to shelf to create resonant positioning for Western Australia’s prized herring.

items.title: Debakarn
items.excerpt: Website refresh and ongoing support for research and educational initiative.
items.summary: Website refresh and ongoing support for research and educational initiative.
items.bodyHtml:
The challenge

Debakarn, meaning “going along steady” in Nyoongar language, is a research and educational initiative based at Curtin University's School of Allied Health. The initiative works to improve accessibility and responsiveness of allied health services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

Debakarn needed a digital presence that could effectively serve multiple audiences (community members, service providers and educators) while honouring the cultural significance of their work. The previous website did not adequately communicate the progress and extent of the initiative, nor did it reflect the principles central to their approach: working biddiya to biddiya (path leader to path leader), shared storying through yarning, being On Country, co-designing solutions and learning to work relationally.

Our approach

OKMG delivered a WordPress redesign and rebuild, focused on readability, accessibility and respectful representation of Aboriginal knowledge and ways of working. The content strategy prioritised clear, purposeful language. We also created a clear navigation structure with targeted pathways enabling community members to engage with relevant content, service providers to access practical frameworks for improving care, and educators to integrate relational ways of working into their teaching.

The design framework incorporated appropriate cultural protocols, including respectful acknowledgment of Country and careful presentation of Elder wisdom and community voices. Visual design choices supported readability through considered typography, generous white space and a calm colour palette that allowed the important content to take centre stage without distraction.

The outcome

The final site is a substantial improvement on the previous design and clearly communicates the progress and extent of the initiative. The website now serves as an effective platform for Debakarn's important work in improving allied health services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

items.title: ISWA
items.excerpt: OKMG’s WordPress redesign for ISWA brings Indian culture to life in Australia, makes community connection effortless, and welcomes every generation.
items.summary: OKMG’s WordPress redesign for ISWA brings Indian culture to life in Australia, makes community connection effortless, and welcomes every generation.
items.bodyHtml:
For over five decades, the Indian Society of Western Australia (ISWA) has been the cultural heartbeat of Perth's Indian diaspora, organising flagship events like Diwali Mela, fostering cross-generational connection, and championing Indian arts, language and heritage. But their website had not kept pace. An aging structure, confusing navigation, and densely packed content were making it difficult for members to find event details, for newcomers to discover how to get involved, and for the society to project the energy and inclusivity that define its real-world presence.

The Brief

Reimagine ISWA's digital presence as a warm, well-organised, and easily usable hub. The new website had to serve a broad audience: long-standing members, young families, recent migrants, and the wider Perth community interested in Indian culture. It needed to make events impossible to miss, simplify membership sign-ups, and celebrate the society's rich history without overwhelming visitors. Central to the brief was a sitemap restructure: adding, deleting and reorganising pages and subpages until the architecture felt as welcoming and logical as a well-run community centre.

Our Approach

From the discovery phase, we mapped distinct user journeys for each key audience: the longtime member looking for an event calendar, the new migrant seeking community connection, the parent exploring cultural language classes for their children, and the sponsor wanting visibility at major celebrations. 

We then turned to the sitemap. We removed redundant pages, merged scattered fragments of related content, and created new, purpose-built sections that had been missing entirely. A dedicated events hub now anchors the site, giving every festival, workshop, and community gathering its own spotlight with clear date, time, and registration details. Membership pathways were streamlined into a dedicated section with straightforward tiers, benefits, and an online sign-up form that feeds directly into the society's database. 

Overall, we brought the warmth of Indian culture onto the screen through a rich, inviting colour palette anchored by crisp, modern layouts. Intuitive navigation and calls-to-action guide visitors naturally from curiosity to participation. We built the site on a responsive, content management framework that gives ISWA's team the autonomy to add events, publish news, and update galleries with ease. SEO foundations ensure the society surfaces prominently when someone searches for Indian cultural events or community groups in Perth.

The Outcome

A digital presence that finally feels like ISWA: vibrant, inclusive, and deeply connected. The restructured site now tells the society's story with clarity and pride, makes it effortless for members and newcomers alike to discover events and join in, and gives the committee a platform they can grow without technical barriers. The website stands as a community gathering place: open to all, alive with culture, and ready to carry the Indian Society of Western Australia into its next chapter.

seo.description: OKMG’s WordPress redesign for ISWA brings Indian culture to life in Australia, makes community connection effortless, and welcomes every generation.

items.summary: OKMG took over Quintilian School's marketing, building custom live dashboards and driving school tours, parent engagement, and enrolments through channel optimisation and budget management while currently refreshing their visual identity and website.
items.bodyHtml:
Overview

Quintilian School is an independent, co-educational and non-religious primary school in the heart of Mount Claremont, Perth, serving students from Pre-Kindergarten to Year 6 since 1975. The school fosters curiosity and problem-solving through a holistic, inquiry-based curriculum that prioritises student-led learning and critical thinking. With a strong community orientation and a commitment to academic excellence alongside emotional wellbeing, social skills and the arts, Quintilian has earned a reputation among Perth's independent schools.

The Brief

Quintilian School faced a familiar challenge for independent schools: a crowded Perth education market and the need to stand out to discerning families. The school’s digital presence had not kept pace with its pedagogical ambition, and the marketing function lacked the data-driven infrastructure to effectively target and convert prospective enrolments.

OKMG was engaged to assist the school’s internal marketing team, with the core objectives to: build custom live dashboards that provide real-time visibility into enrolment funnel performance; establish regular strategic meetings aligned with the school’s annual enrolment milestones; and drive increased enrolments through channel optimisation and rigorous budget management. Alongside this ongoing marketing remit, OKMG is refreshing Quintilian's digital identity with a visual identity update and a full website redesign and development.

Marketing Transformation

The centrepiece of OKMG's marketing remit has been the build and deployment of custom live dashboards. These dashboards consolidate data across the school’s paid media platforms and website analytics into a single, real-time view of the enrolment funnel. For the first time, Quintilian's leadership can see exactly how many inquiries are coming in, where they originate, how quickly they convert to tours, and which channels deliver the highest-quality applications at the lowest cost.

Channel optimisation has also been a core focus. OKMG systematically evaluates the performance of paid search, social media, organic search, referral partnerships and community engagement activities, reallocating budget toward the highest-return channels and cutting spend where performance lags. 

Design and Website Redesign

Alongside the ongoing marketing partnership, OKMG is presently doing a full visual identity refresh and website redesign for Quintilian School. The existing digital presence, while functional, does not adequately convey the warmth, inquiry-driven ethos, and community spirit that define The Quintilian Way.

The redesign process follows OKMG's established methodology: exploring multiple digital design concepts in Figma, pushing the visual application of Quintilian's brand assets, fonts and guidelines. The new visual identity will be refined through iterative feedback rounds before being systematically applied to the entire sitemap.

The new website is being developed to hero the school’s unique approach: the inquiry-based learning model and child-centred philosophy. User journeys are being designed for key audience segments: prospective parents researching school options, families ready to book a tour, and current parents seeking information and community connection. The development phase is delivering a high-performance, self-sufficient platform that empowers Quintilian's team to manage content, update events and publish news without developer dependency.

items.excerpt: OKMG successfully converted Rockford Capital’s vibe-coded website into a polished WordPress lead‑gen engine with calculators converting R&D data to funding estimates.
items.summary: OKMG successfully converted Rockford Capital’s vibe-coded website into a polished WordPress lead‑gen engine with calculators converting R&D data to funding estimates.
items.bodyHtml:
The Client

Rockford Capital, a provider of non-dilutive R&D finance for Australian innovators, specialises in debt capital for ASX-listed and privately held Australian companies with active R&D programs, offering flexible, Australian-sourced capital without requiring founders to issue permanent equity to fund temporary cash gaps. 

The Challenge

The core challenge was twofold: first, to redesign the website to reflect Rockford Capital’s position as a trusted, experienced partner in the R&D financing space; second, to develop advanced financial calculators that would give visitors a tangible, instant understanding of how much non-dilutive capital they could access. These calculators needed to be intuitive and fast while handling multiple variables such as accrued R&D spend, projected future expenditure, cash on hand, and capital raise timing.

Our Approach

OKMG redesigned the website from the ground up, establishing a visual identity that communicates precision, expertise and confidence, all of which are essential qualities for a firm operating at the intersection of finance and innovation. The new design prioritises clarity and conversion. Overall, the redesign vastly improved user journey pathways and conversion flows.

Central to the project was the development of two financial calculators that would serve as compelling lead-generation assets. The R&D Finance Calculator allows users to input their current-year R&D spend, projected 12-month R&D expenditure, cash on hand, and capital raise status to receive an instant estimated advance amount. The Accrued Spend Calculator, on the other hand, provides a complementary view to help companies understand how much working capital they can unlock against historical and current-year R&D expenditure of up to 100% loan-to-value ratio.

We built the entire site on WordPress, providing Rockford Capital’s team with a flexible content management system that enables them to update content, publish insights, and maintain the calculators. 

The Outcome

Here’s a digital presence that matches Rockford Capital's ambition and expertise. The redesigned website now tells the firm’s story with clarity and authority: founded by innovators and entrepreneurs who have experienced firsthand the challenges of building and funding high-growth businesses in Australia. The interactive calculators have become a powerful lead generation tool, giving prospective clients an immediate, tangible understanding of the non-dilutive capital available to them. Meanwhile, the WordPress platform ensures the site remains scalable and manageable, ready to support Rockford Capital’s growth as it continues to back Australian innovators with smarter, faster, non-dilutive funding.

seo.description: OKMG successfully converted Rockford Capital’s vibe-coded website into a polished WordPress lead‑gen engine with calculators converting R&D data to funding estimates.

items.title: Truth Engine

items.summary: OKMG produced a hero video for Truth Engine and refreshed their website to showcase their software product and customer successes.
items.bodyHtml:
Truth Engine is Australia's most comprehensive home building software solution, built by industry experts with over 30 years of construction experience. The platform empowers premium homebuilders with a complete operational toolkit from sales quoting and estimating to purchase orders, variations, claims, cashflow forecasting and beyond. 

The brief was to capture and produce a high production value video that could sit on the HIA website, showcasing Truth Engine's platform to premium homebuilders looking to take their business to the next level. Alongside the video, OKMG was tasked with a website refresh to hero the video, refine their visual identity and build trust with audiences as a progressive and passionate software company. 

Strategy

OKMG approached this project with a content-first strategy, recognising that the video would play a central role in introducing Truth Engine’s platform to potential buyers. Rather than treating the video as a standalone asset, we positioned it as a key asset within a new website homepage, which does a lot of the heavy lifting for customer conversions. 

Video Production

The video production was designed to showcase Truth Engine's platform in action and the positive impact that it has on users at every level. So we had a multi-layered production approach:

  • Studio Interviews. We filmed in-studio interviews with the owner of Truth Engine, capturing the vision, expertise and 30+ years of industry experience that built the platform. Alongside this, we interviewed key stakeholders from various homebuilding businesses. They are real users who could speak authentically to the platform's impact on their day-to-day operations and client relationships.
  • On-Site Footage. Following the studio session, we captured footage across multiple active building sites with the Truth Engine platform in use. This content provided cutaways and B-roll to overlay on the interviews.
  • Platform Screen Recordings. We arranged screen recording of the Truth Engine platform in use, demonstrating key features including the 3D take-off technology, estimating workflows, variation management and cashflow forecasting to show homebuilders exactly how the software works.
  • Animation. To bookend the video, we designed and implemented animated intro and outro slides that reinforce Truth Engine's core messaging: “Do It Once. Do It Right.” and animated branded lower thirds for every testimonial. 

The Outcome

A polished video that tells the Truth Engine story with authenticity and impact now features on the HIA website, reaching Australia's most influential homebuilders exactly where they look for industry solutions. The studio interviews with the owner and client stakeholders, combined with on-site footage and platform demonstrations, creates a compelling narrative. The refreshed website heroes this video and sets the scene so that Truth Engine can communicate their vision and the constantly-increasing value of their product.
